judge.rationale: The candidate completely failed to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the actual fix, leaving the `error instanceof Error` gate in place. Because the production code is unchanged, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/onErrorNonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately, breaking `npm test`. Furthermore, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update specified in the acceptance criteria and left behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` artifact. While the test cases and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` update capture the intent of the issue, stopping after writing the failing test leaves the PR broken and incomplete.
